title: Wendell and the Letters
author: Yara Thackeray
blurb: Beatrix Hartwell, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
